message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"glib/fuzzing/fuzz_variant_binary_byteswap.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":23,"var":"data/size","code":"g_variant_new_from_data (G_VARIANT_TYPE_VARIANT, data, size, FALSE, NULL, NULL)","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are wrapped as a GVariant blob for parsing."},
  {"step":2,"file":"glib/gvariant.c","function":"g_variant_byteswap","line":6098,"var":"value","code":"g_variant_byteswap (variant)","note":"The parsed variant is handed to the byteswap routine that will recurse through its serialized contents."},
  {"step":3,"file":"glib/gvariant.c","function":"g_variant_byteswap","line":6111,"var":"serialised","code":"g_variant_store (value, serialised.data)","note":"For normal-form inputs, the variant is serialized into a writable buffer before swapping."},
  {"step":4,"file":"glib/gvariant-serialiser.c","function":"g_variant_serialised_byteswap","line":1671,"var":"serialised","code":"g_variant_serialised_byteswap (serialised)","note":"The serializer byteswaps the top-level serialized value and descends into container children."},
  {"step":5,"file":"glib/gvariant-serialiser.c","function":"g_variant_serialised_get_child","line":1742,"var":"child","code":"child = g_variant_serialised_get_child (serialised, i)","note":"Child descriptors are derived from attacker-controlled container layout and offsets."},
  {"step":6,"file":"glib/gvariant-serialiser.c","function":"g_variant_serialised_byteswap","line":1743,"var":"child","code":"g_variant_serialised_byteswap (child)","note":"Recursive descent reaches a child whose computed size/layout is inconsistent with the actual serialized buffer."},
  {"step":7,"file":"glib/gvariant-serialiser.c","function":"g_variant_serialised_byteswap","line":1680,"var":"serialised.data","code":"guint16/guint32/guint64 swap through serialised.data","note":"The recursive swap performs a read from the child buffer, triggering the heap-buffer-overflow READ."}
]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print('wrote trace')
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/glib/candidate.bin /workspace/candidate_trace.json
